title: This week at JDHQ – 2026-06-15
summary: The weekly email update, cross-posted here.
content:
Originally sent to the mailing list.

As promised (to ourselves), we've had a bit of time off here in Taiwan. So this is just a quick note to remind you that the first of the weekly Small Business sessions is this Thursday 18th June at 16:00 +8.

That's morning if you're in Europe, daytime for EMEA and into Asia, and evening in Oceania. The session next Tuesday 23rd June at 06:00 +8 is nicer for those of you in the Americas.

Zoom links for both of those are on the SBS events page at JDHQ – subscribe to the calendar there for the most up-to-date information.

We'll be kicking off the annual cycle with something easy, just to test out the process: your travel administration and records. As a reminder, the calendar has been designed to touch every aspect of your business over the course of the year. It's a light check-in to make sure that everything's in order and that you haven't forgotten, say, to renew your company's annual travel insurance policy.

I'll be sending those of you who asked for the Baserow template a link in the next couple of days. We'll go through it in the session so there's no pre-work required.

Of course if you're not already in the Small Business System, there's still time to upgrade your account. See you Thursday.

j.
